subject: Re: Proposal update
text:
Hey,

I owe you an apology, and I wanted to explain before the week slides away. The proposal update was supposed to land in your inbox by Tuesday, but I got tangled up with another deadline and then realized I had not actually saved the revised page numbers we discussed. Since we are still settling into working together, I feel especially bad about wasting your time. You mentioned earlier that the budget table needed clearer columns, so I reworked that section, added the revised timeline, and made the assumptions more visible. I also remembered that I forgot the missing attachment in my last message, which is probably why the file seemed incomplete. It is not your fault at all, and I should have caught it the first time.

I attached the updated package now. It has three tabs: the short summary, the detailed schedule, and the open questions list. The changes are highlighted so you can scan them quickly. If the dates still feel ambitious, we can move the soft launch by four days without affecting the rest. I can also send a shorter version if you need something you can skim before your meeting.

Thanks for being patient while I sorted this out. I really appreciate your understanding. Please tell me which part feels off, and I will tighten it before Friday. No rush on wording notes before then.
